narrative.overview:
The interface extends the existing light neutral starter. Pale gray ground, white reading surfaces, dark slate text, and restrained blue controls make questions and source passages easy to scan. System typography is the confirmed incumbent choice; this document records that choice without proposing a replacement identity.

This is an extracted record of the shared workspace styles, navigation, question page, comparison page, local corpus administration, and original-passage inspector in `frontend/app/`. Tokens describe reused shipped values; they do not establish a new component library. Product behavior remains in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md); surface contracts remain in [search_surface.md](search_surface.md) [comparison_surface.md](comparison_surface.md), and [admin_surface.md](admin_surface.md).
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light surfaces with blue interaction cues.
Flat grouping through whitespace and fine rules.
Comfortable reading measures and visible source selection.
Explicit provisional, empty, stopped, and failed states.

rules.name: The Interaction Cue Rule
rules.body: Blue identifies an action, a selected source, or request activity; neutral surfaces carry reading content.

rules.name: The Passage Fidelity Rule
rules.body: Preserve passage whitespace and wrap long strings; original text is read in the same sans family as the interface rather than restyled as a code block.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve the incumbent hierarchy of rules and tonal fills when extending an existing container.

dos: Do retain neutral reading surfaces and blue interaction cues.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and native form semantics.
Do preserve passage whitespace and wrap long source identifiers.
Do stack the source inspector below the answer at the existing mobile breakpoint.
Do keep provisional answer states and source provenance explicit.
donts: Don't introduce a new visual identity into this bounded extension.
Don't use selection or error color as the only state explanation.
Don't add shadows to the existing flat containers.
Don't make the source-selection animation run for reduced-motion users.
Don't imply that checked citation membership proves factual support.
